en.adminOps.planConfig.gateLabel: Technician must have at least this many reviews total
en.adminOps.planConfig.minFour: Minimum number of reviews rated 4 or higher
en.adminOps.planConfig.warning: Changing these criteria does not retroactively demote existing Senior Pro technicians. It only affects future promotions. To manually demote a technician, visit their profile in the Technicians section.
